title: Audit of accounts of** [1][auqaf]
text:
47. Audit of accounts of [auqaf].—(1) The accounts of [auqaf] submitted to the Board under

section 46 shall be audited and examined in the following manner, namely:—

(a) in the case of a [waqf] having no income or a net annual income not exceeding

4[fifty thousand rupees], the submission of a statement of accounts shall be a sufficient compliance
with the provisions of section 46 and the accounts of two per cent. of such [auqaf] shall be audited
annually by an auditor appointed by the Board;

(b) the accounts of the [waqf] having net annual income exceeding [fifty thousand rupees] shall
